description: Typed TypeScript SDK for supported Tradernet API v2 user profile data, broker reports, user cash flows, portfolio snapshots, and read-only orders.
rules: Import TradernetApiClient, constants, and types only from @kofeinstyle/tradernet-sdk.
Check response.success before accessing response.data or error fields.
Use getUserProfile to retrieve homeCurrency and main_curr without exposing the complete getOPQ payload.
Use getBrokerReport with corporate_actions for security-level dividend details and getUserCashFlows for account ledger operations.
Use getPortfolio for the current read-only account balances and open positions.
Use getOrders for current-period orders and getOrdersHistory for an explicit date range.
Use OrderStatuses for documented order status codes; OrderStatus intentionally also accepts unknown numeric codes.
Use OrderOperations, OrderTypes, and OrderExpirations instead of unnamed numeric order codes.
Broker reports default to the 23:59:59 time period unless 08:40:00 is explicitly required.
Do not suggest API v3, WebSocket, order placement, or other methods that are not part of the documented public API.
